install:
set -euo pipefail

# --- system basics (idempotent) ---
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq \
    build-essential curl ca-certificates pkg-config \
    python3 python3-pip python3-venv python3-dev \
    >/dev/null
fi

# --- Rust stable + rustfmt + clippy ---
export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}"
export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}"
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs \
    | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal
fi
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
[ -f "$CARGO_HOME/env" ] && . "$CARGO_HOME/env"
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
rustup default stable
rustup component add rustfmt clippy
rustc --version
cargo --version

# --- Python 3.11+ and pip ---
PY=""
for cand in python3.13 python3.12 python3.11 python3; do
  if command -v "$cand" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ver="$("$cand" -c 'import sys; print("%d.%d"%sys.version_info[:2])')"
    major="${ver%%.*}"; minor="${ver#*.}"
    if [ "$major" -gt 3 ] || { [ "$major" -eq 3 ] && [ "$minor" -ge 11 ]; }; then
      PY="$cand"
      break
    fi
  fi
done
if [ -z "$PY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: need Python 3.11+ (python3.11/3.12/3.13 or python3>=3.11)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
"$PY" -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
"$PY" --version
"$PY" -m pip --version

# --- maturin + project Python deps (when present) ---
"$PY" -m pip install 'maturin>=1.7,<2'
if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
  # Runtime + common CI/dev extras without forcing an editable build yet.
  "$PY" -m pip install 'numpy>=1.24' 'pytest>=7' 'scipy>=1.10' 'ruff>=0.5'
  # Optional: if requirements*.txt exist, install them too.
  for req in requirements.txt requirements-dev.txt; do
    if [ -f "$req" ]; then
      "$PY" -m pip install -r "$req"
    fi
  done
elif ls requirements*.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for req in requirements*.txt; do
    "$PY" -m pip install -r "$req"
  done
fi

# --- warm Cargo / PyO3 caches (no long-running services) ---
if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then
  cargo fetch
  # Compile tests without running them so the Build caches crates + artifacts.
  cargo test -p traceot-core --no-run
  cargo test -p traceot-core --no-default-features --no-run
fi
# Warm the extension build path (writes wheels under target/; disk state is kept).
if [ -f pyproject.toml ] && [ -f crates/py/Cargo.toml ]; then
  mkdir -p /tmp/traceot-wheels
  "$PY" -m maturin build --release -o /tmp/traceot-wheels
fi

echo "traceot cloud env install complete"
